it.title: Bari, alla Caserma Picca il concerto “Inno alla Vita” a sostegno di Fondazione Telethon
it.description: BARI - Giovedì 2 luglio alle ore 20.30, presso la Caserma Picca di Bari, si terrà la terza edizione del concerto benefico “Inno alla Vita – L’Esercito per Fondazione Telethon”, organizzato in collaborazione con il Comando Militare Esercito “Puglia”. L’evento, inserito nelle iniziative celebrative degli 80 anni della Repubblica, vedrà l’esibizione della Banda dell’Esercito Italiano, complesso musicale istituzionale rappresentativo della Forza Armata. Nel corso della sua attività, la formazione si è esibita in alcuni dei più prestigiosi teatri italiani e internazionali, tra cui il Teatro alla Scala di Milano, il Teatro Massimo di Palermo, il Teatro San Carlo di Napoli, il Teatro Petruzzelli di Bari, il Teatro dell’Opera di Roma e La Fenice di Venezia, oltre che al Festival dei Due Mondi di Spoleto e al Festival di Sanremo, collaborando con artisti di fama mondiale. La sua interpretazione dell’Inno nazionale è stata inoltre inserita tra i simboli della Repubblica sul sito del Quirinale. Per l’edizione 2026 del concerto, la Banda proporrà un programma intitolato “La Banda suona il Cinema”, con l’esecuzione di celebri colonne sonore della storia del cinema, con l’obiettivo di sostenere la raccolta fondi destinata alla ricerca sulle malattie genetiche rare. L’iniziativa si inserisce nel 35° anno di collaborazione tra Esercito Italiano e Fondazione Telethon. L’evento è organizzato con il supporto del Comando Militare Esercito Puglia e si svolgerà nella cornice della Caserma Domenico Picca, dove nel piazzale saranno allestiti circa 1.000 posti a sedere suddivisi in tre settori con differenti contributi di accesso. In particolare, sono previsti 360 posti con contributo di 20 euro, 480 posti con contributo di 15 euro e 160 posti con contributo di 10 euro. È possibile partecipare tramite biglietteria elettronica e donazione online attraverso la piattaforma indicata dagli organizzatori, oppure richiedendo informazioni via e-mail con allegata ricevuta di donazione. L’iniziativa punta a superare i risultati delle precedenti edizioni, rafforzando il sostegno alla ricerca scientifica nel campo delle malattie genetiche rare attraverso la partecipazione del pubblico e la raccolta fondi solidale.

co.title: Cencosud compra Makro Colombia por US$158 millones y fortalece su negocio mayorista
co.description: Cencosud anunció la adquisición del 100% de Makro Supermayorista en Colombia, una operación valorada en aproximadamente US$158 millones que fortalece su estrategia de crecimiento en la región y consolida su apuesta por el negocio mayorista o Cash & Carry. La compra fue realizada a través de su filial Cencosud Internacional SpA y será financiada en su totalidad con recursos propios, según informó la compañía. El cierre de la transacción aún está sujeto al cumplimiento de las condiciones habituales para este tipo de operaciones, entre ellas la autorización de la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC). Con esta adquisición, Cencosud incorpora una red de 21 establecimientos distribuidos en 16 ciudades colombianas, entre ellas Bogotá, Medellín, Cali y Barranquilla. Makro acumula más de 25 años de operación en Colombia y se ha especializado en la venta al por mayor dirigida a clientes profesionales, comerciantes, restaurantes, hoteles y emprendedores, un segmento que la compañía chilena considera estratégico para continuar su expansión. La integración permitirá a Cencosud sumar por primera vez el formato mayorista a su operación en Colombia, ampliando su cobertura comercial y fortaleciendo su presencia en uno de los mercados más importantes de la región. La compañía explicó que la incorporación de Makro abre oportunidades para desarrollar sinergias operacionales, logísticas y comerciales, aprovechando la infraestructura y la experiencia de ambas empresas. Además, considera que el segmento mayorista ofrece un importante potencial de crecimiento en Colombia, lo que permitirá ampliar la propuesta de valor para clientes profesionales y emprendedores. “La compra de Makro representa una oportunidad para fortalecer nuestra operación en Colombia y ampliar nuestra propuesta para clientes que buscan soluciones mayoristas, con foco en servicio, surtido y competitividad”, afirmó Ramiro Ortiz, gerente país de Cencosud en Colombia. La compra de Makro Colombia se suma a la estrategia de expansión regional que viene ejecutando Cencosud en el negocio mayorista. La empresa recordó que en 2025 adquirió las operaciones de Makro en Argentina y que también opera Giga en Brasil, fortaleciendo su presencia en el formato Cash & Carry en América Latina. Con la incorporación de Makro Colombia, Cencosud continúa ampliando su plataforma regional de comercio mayorista y refuerza su posición en un segmento que gana relevancia por la creciente demanda de soluciones de abastecimiento para negocios, comerciantes y emprendedores. co.title: Colombiana se coronó campeona mundial de apnea
co.description: Colombiana se coronó campeona mundial de apnea sreyes Vie, 26/06/2026 - 16:05 Fecha nodo Vie, 26/06/2026 - 16:25 Image /sites/default/files/imagenes/2026/06/Nota%201%20-%20%C2%BFQuiere%20ver%20a%20Colombia%20en%20el%20mundial%20Esto%20le%20podr%C3%ADa%20costar%20%288%29.jpg Body Paula Aguirre escribió una nueva página dorada para el deporte colombiano al proclamarse campeona del Campeonato Mundial de Apnea en Piscina , disputado en Atenas, Grecia . La deportista se quedó con la medalla de oro en la prueba de dinámica con bialetas (Dynamic Bi-Fins) , gracias a un recorrido de 277 metros , marca con la que superó a las principales favoritas y confirmó el crecimiento de Colombia en esta disciplina. La actuación de la colombiana fue una de las más destacadas del certamen organizado por la Confederación Mundial de Actividades Subacuáticas (CMAS) . Además del título mundial, Aguirre mostró un alto nivel técnico y una gran capacidad física para imponerse en una competencia que reunió a algunos de los mejores apneístas del planeta. Un deporte que exige resistencia física y mental La apnea es una disciplina que consiste en recorrer la mayor distancia posible o permanecer el mayor tiempo bajo el agua sin utilizar equipos de respiración. En la modalidad de dinámica con bialetas, los deportistas emplean dos aletas para impulsarse mientras contienen la respiración, una prueba que exige preparación física, concentración y un estricto control mental. Tras conseguir la medalla de oro, Paula Aguirre expresó su emoción por representar al país y agradeció el respaldo recibido durante su preparación. "Este resultado es fruto de muchos años de trabajo, disciplina y sacrificio. Llevar la bandera de Colombia a lo más alto del podio es un orgullo inmenso", manifestó la deportista en declaraciones compartidas por la organización del campeonato y medios nacionales. El título de Aguirre se suma a los recientes éxitos internacionales del deporte colombiano y ratifica el crecimiento de disciplinas que, aunque tienen menor exposición mediática que otras, continúan entregando resultados de alto nivel. Su victoria también vuelve a poner el foco sobre la apnea, una modalidad que gana cada vez más practicantes y reconocimiento en el país. Creado por REDACCIÓN DEPORTES

in.title: From Nollywood to Military Service: Joseph Momodu Joins U.S. Army After Grueling Training
in.source: Brand Icon Image - Latest Brand, Tech And Business
in.description: Nollywood actor Joseph Momodu has announced a major life transition, revealing that he has officially enlisted in the United States Army after completing a demanding training programme. The actor shared the news on Friday via his verified Instagram page, where he detailed his journey through 10 weeks of Basic Combat Training at Fort Leonard Wood in Missouri. According to him, the experience marked not only a career shift but also a deeply personal milestone tied to his family history. Momodu, who is now officially serving as a Specialist (SPC) in the U.S. Army, described the journey as one defined by endurance, discipline, and self-discovery. “From inception, I have always believed in achievements earned through merit, which is why I constantly push myself beyond limits,” he wrote, reflecting on the mindset that carried him through the intense programme. He did not shy away from describing how physically and mentally demanding the training was, noting that it pushed him into unfamiliar territory. According to him, the process involved “tears, fear of failure, resilience, endless days, short nights, fatigue, rain, and the scorching sun.” Momodu admitted there were moments of self-doubt during the rigorous exercise, but said he stayed committed to finishing what he started. At one point, he even questioned himself in a lighthearted but honest expression: “who send me message sef?” Despite the pressure, he said the transformation was total and unavoidable. “We trained tirelessly, were broken down and rebuilt. I went to sleep a civilian and woke up a soldier,” he shared, adding that the experience taught him to “find comfort in discomfort.” Beyond the physical achievement, the enlistment also carries emotional weight for the actor. He revealed that joining the U.S. Army was his way of honouring his late father, connecting the milestone to a legacy of public service. “On April 12, 2026, I honored my late father in a historic way. Twenty years after his passing, I picked up the baton where he left off in the Nigerian Police Force and carried it forward by getting enlisted into the United States Army,” he stated. Momodu confirmed that he now serves as Specialist J.A. Momodu with the 1st Platoon, Charlie Company, 3-10, 3rd Battalion, 10th Infantry Regiment, based at Fort Leonard Wood, Missouri. He dedicated the achievement to God, his late father, and the Royal Family of Oba Momodu II of the Avyuele Clan in Agbede, Edo State, while also acknowledging the support he received from the U.S. Army Recruiting Station in Burbank, California. He further appreciated associate Akeem Ogara, who helped manage his social media presence throughout the training period, marking the end of one chapter and the beginning of another in both his military and personal journey.

sg.title: Givenchy Unveils Sarah Burton's First Men's Collection & Moschino Enlists Sunnei Designers
sg.description: SummaryRick Owens, Dior Men, and Saint Laurent presented their Spring/Summer 2027 menswear collections at Paris Fashion Week, focusing on climate-tech, material replication, and minimalist staging.Givenchy previewed Sarah Burton's new direction with a lo-fi London campaign shot by Juergen Teller.Moschino appointed Sunnei founders Loris Messina and Simone Rizzo as its new co-creative directors.Rick Owens Menswear Spring/Summer 2027 “STONE” Collection Runway Paris Fashion WeekRick Owens held his Spring/Summer 2027 show at the Palais de Tokyo during a Paris heatwave, introducing a timely collaboration with adidas. The lineup debuted pieces built with adidas ClimaCool technology, featuring fan-inflated jackets and shorts paired with internal ice vests designed to regulate body temperature. Owens also previewed a new high-performance running shoe set for 2027. Alongside the athletic wear, the collection included avant-garde hand-crafted pieces. Rubber designer Matisse Di Maggio created sheer, hand-piped latex tops that required over 35 hours of labor each, while long-time collaborator Straytukay designed skeletal "Tensegrity" chaps made of foam and latex. Models walked the steel-grate runway in a palette of black, brown, and beige, wearing over-the-knee leather platform boots styled over three-striped track pants.Dior Men Summer 2027 Collection Paris Fashion Week Runway Show InfoFor Dior Men’s Summer 2027 collection, Jonathan Anderson prioritized material manipulation and replication over traditional textile construction. The house printed houndstooth patterns directly onto fabrics instead of weaving them, and formed polka dots out of solid fields of sequins. A standout piece was an embroidered silk shirt that recreated a trompe l'oeil scarf graphic from 1979 Dior haute couture. The footwear subverted classics, featuring suede lace-up shoes hand-embroidered with 19th-century motifs and intentionally disheveled woven boots. In accessories, Anderson converted a vintage zig-zag woven blanket into a tote bag and applied Dior's archival cannage quilting to casual, spongy denim. The show’s music, a custom mix by Fred again..., mirrored this design ethos by sampling and remixing familiar vocal and instrumental tracks into new arrangements.Givenchy Taps Juergen Teller for Sarah Burton's First Men's CampaignNewly appointed Givenchy Creative Director Sarah Burton joined forces with photographer Juergen Teller to shoot her first menswear campaign for the house. The portraits feature photographer Sir Don McCullin, filmmaker Don Letts, and painter Danny Fox modeling tailored garments they chose themselves. Teller photographed the cast across casual, everyday locations in London, resulting in a lo-fi aesthetic. McCullin wore a gray double-breasted suit jacket with brogues, Fox was styled in a bright yellow coat and a collarless black suit, and Letts wore an all-white suit alongside a gold floral overcoat. The campaign images were scheduled to appear on billboards across Paris to coincide with Burton’s formal runway debut on June 25.Saint Laurent Summer 2027 Menswear Runway Collection Anthony Vaccarello Paris Fashion WeekAnthony Vaccarello focused on restraint and minimalist design for Saint Laurent’s Summer 2027 menswear collection. The presentation took place inside artist Fujiko Nakaya’s immersive fog installation, "Cloud #07156," where models drifted through a thick white mist. Vaccarello designed tailored pieces inspired by style figures like Tina Chow and author Marguerite Duras, introducing high-cut three-button jackets, bare-skin waistcoats, and low-cut tops paired with trailing fabric chokers. While grey, black, brown, and beige formed the foundational color palette, the looks were punctuated by hits of orange, claret, and lime. The collection concluded with liquid-gold metallic finishes on utilitarian outerwear, including a double-breasted suit and a belted trench coat. The models completed their looks with sheer, high-gloss shoes that caught the ambient light and fogged up in the moisture.Moschino Names Sunnei Founders Loris Messina and Simone Rizzo as Creative DirectorsMoschino named Sunnei founders Loris Messina and Simone Rizzo as its new co-creative directors. The appointment followed the sudden departure of former creative director Adrian Appiolaza just days prior. Messina and Rizzo launched their independent Milanese label Sunnei in 2014, gaining recognition for humor, community projects, and interactive runway shows before stepping away from the brand in September 2025. Massimo Ferretti, Executive Chairman of Moschino’s parent company Aeffe S.p.A., stated that the duo possesses the cultural sensibility needed to restructure the label while respecting its history. The designers noted their long-standing admiration for founder Franco Moschino’s ironical take on pop culture and luxury. Messina and Rizzo will show their debut collection for Moschino during Milan Fashion Week. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

sg.title: The Art of the Clock Out, According to Temi Ibisanmi
sg.description: Logging off is part of the job for any creative. Behind every best idea is the feeling of being inspired, a time to take it all in. Take Temi Ibisanmi, for example: whether he’s putting together his next look or kicking it back with friends, it’s all part of the creative process. Because knowing when to step away is just as important as locking in.Ibisanmi, better known as @tolutemi, is a Nigerian-American, New York-based model and creative director with a love for fashion, travel, and culture. In front of or behind the camera, he stays rooted in the present, grounding himself in those everyday moments that too often pass us by.As the week comes to a close, as summer sets in, Ibisanmi walks Hypebeast through his Clock Out Ritual in Brooklyn. To celebrate the first summer of Berry Rouge, Grey Goose’s new flavored vodka, we’re following tastemakers across New York City to learn how they’re raising a glass to the weekend and ushering in that perfect Summer Friday vibe.We first caught up with Ibisanmi in his Bed-Stuy apartment. He’s wrapping up the last few tasks of the week. A glance through the living room makes clear that style is king for the multi-hyphenate, whose space felt like an extension of his fit: classic shapes, palettes, and silhouettes elevated by thoughtful, eclectic accents. For him, the outfit is the medium, and the art is in the details. There’s an effortless cool to today’s look, from the base pieces to the accessories.He shuts his laptop after that one final email, and the group chat comes alive about plans later on. And just like that, the weekend is underway.A walk through the park and a stop at his favorite concept store made for a much-needed refresh from a busy week. Ibisanmi browsed through the racks and found some new pickups for his ring collection before settling in with a berry pastry to refuel for the next stop. It’s the small pleasures that made the reset complete.As the afternoon set in, Ibisanmi linked up with friends, Jamie and Alberto, at a nearby bar. The conversation was easy, and the mood, unmistakably summer. With a refreshing round of Rouge Royales in hand, the moment feels tailored to the season. Made with the Grey Goose Berry Rouge Flavored Vodka, fresh lemonade, and sparkling rosé, the cocktail brings an effervescent brightness to the table, just a taste of those summer days ahead.Check out the video above for a closer look at Ibisanmi’s Clock Out Ritual. Grey Goose Berry Rouge is now available at select retailers nationwide and online. Head to the brand's website for the full Rouge Royale recipe. Read more at Hypebeast

id.title: Givenchy Rilis Koleksi Menswear Perdana Sarah Burton & Moschino Gaet Desainer Sunnei
id.description: RingkasanRick Owens, Dior Men, dan Saint Laurent membuka rangkaian koleksi menswear Spring/Summer 2027 mereka di Paris Fashion Week, dengan fokus pada climate tech, replikasi material, dan tata panggung minimalis.Givenchy memberi bocoran arah baru Sarah Burton lewat kampanye bernuansa lo-fi di London yang dibidik oleh Juergen Teller.Moschino menunjuk duo pendiri Sunnei, Loris Messina dan Simone Rizzo, sebagai co-creative director terbaru.Rick Owens Menswear Spring/Summer 2027 “STONE” Collection Runway Paris Fashion WeekRick Owens menggelar show Spring/Summer 2027 di Palais de Tokyo di tengah gelombang panas Paris, sekaligus memperkenalkan kolaborasi terkini dengan adidas. Koleksi ini menampilkan deretan look baru yang dibangun dengan teknologi adidas ClimaCool, termasuk jaket dan celana pendek berisi kipas yang dipadu rompi es internal untuk membantu mengatur suhu tubuh. Owens juga memberi bocoran sepatu lari high-performance terbaru yang dijadwalkan meluncur pada 2027. Di samping activewear, koleksi ini turut menghadirkan karya-karya avant-garde buatan tangan. Desainer karet Matisse Di Maggio menciptakan atasan lateks tipis dengan piping tangan yang masing-masing membutuhkan lebih dari 35 jam pengerjaan, sementara kolaborator lama Straytukay merancang chaps rangka "Tensegrity" dari busa dan lateks. Para model melangkah di atas runway baja berjeruji dalam palet hitam, cokelat, dan beige, mengenakan platform boots kulit setinggi paha yang ditata menutupi track pants tiga garis ikonik.Dior Men Summer 2027 Collection Paris Fashion Week Runway Show InfoUntuk koleksi Summer 2027 Dior Men, Jonathan Anderson memprioritaskan manipulasi dan replikasi material ketimbang konstruksi tekstil tradisional. Rumah mode ini mencetak motif houndstooth langsung ke atas kain alih-alih menenunnya, dan membentuk polkadot dari bidang sequin padat. Salah satu highlight koleksi adalah kemeja sutra bordir yang menghidupkan kembali grafis syal trompe l'oeil dari Dior haute couture tahun 1979. Koleksi footwear menggoyang pakem klasik, menghadirkan sepatu lace-up suede yang dibordir tangan dengan motif abad ke-19 serta boots anyaman yang sengaja dibuat tampak berantakan. Untuk aksesori, Anderson mengubah selimut tenun zig-zag vintage menjadi tas tote dan menerapkan quilting cannage arsip Dior pada denim kasual bertekstur empuk. Musik show, sebuah custom mix dari Fred again..., mencerminkan etos desain ini dengan menyampel dan me-remix track vokal dan instrumental familiar menjadi aransemen baru.Givenchy Menggandeng Juergen Teller untuk Kampanye Menswear Perdana Sarah BurtonCreative Director Givenchy yang baru diangkat, Sarah Burton, berkolaborasi dengan fotografer Juergen Teller untuk menggarap kampanye menswear perdananya untuk rumah mode tersebut. Potret-potret ini menampilkan fotografer Sir Don McCullin, pembuat film Don Letts, dan pelukis Danny Fox yang mengenakan tailoring pilihan mereka sendiri. Teller memotret para talenta di lokasi-lokasi kasual dan sehari-hari di London, menghasilkan estetika lo-fi. McCullin mengenakan jaket jas double-breasted abu-abu dengan brogues, Fox tampil dalam mantel kuning terang dan setelan hitam tanpa kerah, sementara Letts memakai setelan serba putih yang dipadu overcoat floral emas. Gambar kampanye ini dijadwalkan muncul di billboard di seluruh Paris bertepatan dengan debut runway resmi Burton pada 25 Juni.Saint Laurent Summer 2027 Menswear Runway Collection Anthony Vaccarello Paris Fashion WeekAnthony Vaccarello mengedepankan kesederhanaan dan desain minimalis untuk koleksi menswear Summer 2027 Saint Laurent. Presentasi berlangsung di dalam instalasi kabut imersif karya seniman Fujiko Nakaya, "Cloud #07156," tempat para model melayang di tengah kabut putih pekat. Vaccarello merancang deretan tailoring yang terinspirasi figur gaya seperti Tina Chow dan penulis Marguerite Duras, menghadirkan jaket tiga kancing berpotongan tinggi, rompi yang memperlihatkan kulit, serta atasan berpotongan rendah yang dipadu choker kain menjuntai. Sementara abu-abu, hitam, cokelat, dan beige menjadi fondasi palet warna, tiap look diberi semburat oranye, claret, dan lime. Koleksi ditutup dengan sentuhan metalik bak "liquid gold" pada outerwear utilitarian, termasuk setelan double-breasted dan trench coat berikat pinggang. Para model menyempurnakan tampilan dengan sepatu transparan berkilau tinggi yang memantulkan cahaya sekitar dan berembun oleh kelembapan.Moschino Mengangkat Pendiri Sunnei Loris Messina dan Simone Rizzo sebagai Creative DirectorMoschino menunjuk duo pendiri Sunnei, Loris Messina dan Simone Rizzo, sebagai co-creative director baru. Penunjukan ini menyusul kepergian mendadak creative director sebelumnya, Adrian Appiolaza, hanya beberapa hari sebelumnya. Messina dan Rizzo meluncurkan label independen asal Milan, Sunnei, pada 2014, dan dikenal lewat humor, proyek komunitas, serta runway show interaktif sebelum mundur dari brand tersebut pada September 2025. Massimo Ferretti, Executive Chairman perusahaan induk Moschino, Aeffe S.p.A., menyatakan bahwa keduanya memiliki kepekaan kultural yang dibutuhkan untuk merestrukturisasi label sambil tetap menghormati sejarahnya. Kedua desainer itu menegaskan kekaguman lama mereka pada cara Franco Moschino, sang pendiri, mengolah pop culture dan luxury dengan sentuhan ironi. Messina dan Rizzo akan menampilkan koleksi debut mereka untuk Moschino di ajang Milan Fashion Week. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

bd.title: Frost & Sullivan Institute Honors Organizations Driving Transformative Impact Through Visionary Leadership
bd.description: SILICON VALLEY, Calif. , June 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Frost & Sullivan Institute is proud to announce the recipients of the 2026 Visionary Growth Leadership Best Practices Recognition, honoring organizations that are setting new benchmarks for business leadership by tackling some of the world's most critical challenges. This recognition celebrates enterprises that have successfully aligned innovation, sustainable growth, and positive societal impact, demonstrating that long-term business success is strengthened by a commitment to creating meaningful change. The award recognizes companies whose forward-thinking strategies and solutions are helping shape a more resilient, equitable, and sustainable future. The 2026 honorees exemplify a new model of leadership in which purpose and performance are deeply interconnected. Across industries including renewable energy, climate adaptation, healthcare, cybersecurity, digital access, education, sustainable infrastructure, and resource management, these organizations are delivering scalable solutions that address complex global needs. Through technological innovation, responsible stewardship, and effective execution, they are generating measurable benefits for communities, economies, and industries while advancing sustainable growth. Their achievements reflect the growing expectation that organizations create value not only for shareholders, but for society. "The recipients of the Visionary Growth Leadership Recognition illustrate how innovation and impact have become essential drivers of sustainable growth," said David Frigstad, Executive Director of the Frost & Sullivan Institute. "By addressing critical global challenges with purpose, agility, and strategic vision, these organizations are redefining what leadership looks like in today's world. Their accomplishments demonstrate that enduring market success is built upon resilience, responsible growth, and the ability to deliver measurable value to stakeholders and society alike." Award recipients were selected through Frost & Sullivan Institute's comprehensive research and evaluation framework. Analysts assessed organizations across key impact pillars, including Healthcare, Human Rights, Economics, Environment, Education, Security, and Infrastructure. The evaluation focused on each organization's capacity to develop and implement innovative solutions that drive meaningful progress while creating lasting value at both industry and societal levels. The Frost & Sullivan Institute extends its heartfelt congratulations to the following recipients of the 2026 Visionary Growth Leadership Best Practices Recognition and applauds their continued commitment to advancing innovation, sustainable development, and positive global impact. The successful Emergency Caesarean Section, which safely delivered a healthy baby girl and boy while saving the life of their mother, marks a major milestone for Pomio District and surrounding remote communities that have for generations faced enormous difficulties accessing specialist healthcare. That must continue to change. The safe delivery of these twins at Pomio District Hospital is more than a medical success story. ae.title: Wilder World Unveils Season Zero: The Invasion in Its 5D Metaverse
ae.description: In Brief: Wilder World introduced Season Zero: The Invasion on June 26, featuring structured gameplay. High-stakes combat and resource extraction serve as the season's core activities, with players gathering MILD and Shards. This foundational season is designed to lay groundwork for future updates and competitive elements within the metaverse. Launch of Season Zero in Wilder World Wilder World has officially launched Season Zero: The Invasion, signifying a crucial development in its metaverse progression. Announced via the studio's official ZINE on June 26, this season introduces the first structured gameplay within the virtual city of Wiami, setting the stage for future expansions. Combat and Resource Extraction Mechanics In Season Zero, players are thrust into an environment where they must fend off invading forces. The dual objective of surviving enemy attacks and extracting valuable resources like MILD places players in a constant balance of risk versus reward. The deeper players venture into Wiami, the greater the perils and the potential rewards. Resource extraction is also a key element, with players able to gather Shards at the EZK Neural Station. Wilder World has implemented several updates to enhance gameplay, including improvements to enemy AI, which now offers more strategic combat and better navigation. Risk-Based Strategic Gameplay The gameplay mechanics in Season Zero emphasize strategic risk management. Players must decide whether to risk valuable gear in high-threat areas, with an option to secure items in City Storage located in Agora Alley. This extraction-style gameplay encourages careful planning and decision-making, enhancing the overall stakes of the game. The Expansive Metaverse Wilder World operates within a 5D metaverse constructed with Ethereum and Unreal Engine 5, portraying a virtual Miami where all in-game assets are NFTs. Players engage in transactions using the WILD token. The project, backed by substantial investments including $30 million in USDC and partnerships with firms like Animoca Brands, is poised for significant growth. Technology and Future Developments Operating on a proprietary system named ZERO, which supports identity and communication, Wilder World integrates both web2 and web3 logins and utilizes zXP protocol for tracking in-game progression. Future plans include launching Z Chain, a dedicated blockchain designed to enhance scalability and reduce dependence on Ethereum. Continuous Evolution of Gameplay Season Zero marks just the beginning of what Wilder World envisions as a series of gameplay evolutions, with each season building on the last based on community feedback. This approach ensures a dynamic and competitive environment reflective of player interactions and preferences. With the inauguration of Season Zero: The Invasion, Wilder World invites players to immerse themselves in a meticulously crafted battle and resource-gathering experience, thereby cementing its metaverse as a dynamic and engaging virtual ecosystem.

ae.title: 2026 World Cup breaks all-time attendance record with 3.6 million fans
ae.description: New Jersey: The 2026 World Cup on Thursday became the best attended tournament in World Cup history, surpassing the 1994 record of nearly 3.6 million spectators, FIFA said. The announcement came during the second half of Germany’s match against Ecuador in East Rutherford, New Jersey, as giant screens displayed the new all time high attendance figure of 3,605,357 to loud applause from supporters inside the stadium. With 48 matches still remaining in the tournament, total attendance could potentially almost double the 1994 record, which was set during an era when the World Cup featured only 52 matches. Stadiums at the 2026 tournament have been more than 99% full on average. FIFA President Gianni Infantino said the achievement reflects the global passion for football and its ability to bring people together in an atmosphere of joy and celebration, noting that the scenes witnessed across the 16 host cities and their stadiums had been exceptional.

نتنياهو بعد الاتفاق مع لبنان: حققنا إنجازاً كبيراً لإسرائيل
iq.description: شفق نيوز- الشرق الأوسط وصف رئيس الوزراء الإسرائيلي بنيامين نتنياهو، مساء الجمعة، توقيع اتفاق الإطار مع لبنان بـ"الإنجاز الكبير" لإسرائيل. وذكر نتنياهو في تصريحات تابعتها وكالة شفق نيوز، أن "اتفاق الإطار ضربة قوية لإيران التي حاولت فرض انسحاب علينا من جنوب لبنان، ويؤكد الاتفاق عدم وجود دور لإيران وحزب الله في لبنان، وحققنا إنجازاً كبيراً لإسرائيل". وأضاف نتنياهو: "سنسمح بتمكين الجيش اللبناني من بدء السيطرة على منطقتين تجريبيتين بجنوب لبنان، وإسرائيل ستبقى في الحزام الأمني حتى تجريد حزب الله من سلاحه". إلى ذلك قالت رئاسة الوزراء الإسرائيلية: "وقعنا مع لبنان إطار عمل يهدف للتوصل إلى اتفاقات مستقبلية، وأن إطار العمل الثلاثي مع لبنان يمثل إنجازاً كبيراً لإسرائيل وهو ينهي محاولات إيران فرض انسحاب كامل من جنوب لبنان ويمنع إيران وحزب الله من أي دور في لبنان". وأضافت الرئاسة: "اتفقنا مع لبنان على مشروع تجريبي لنزع سلاح حزب الله سينفذ بجنوب وشمال نهر الليطاني خارج الخط الأصفر بمنطقتين قريبتين من الخط الأصفر". وأكدت: "سنحافظ على حرية العمل العسكري داخل الشريط الأمني بلبنان وسنحافظ على الشريط الأمني في لبنان حتى نزع سلاح حزب الله". ووقع لبنان وإسرائيل، الجمعة، على "اتفاق إطاري" بعد 4 أيام من المفاوضات التي استضافتها واشنطن برعاية أميركية، في أول اختراق بمسار تنفيذ اتفاق وقف إطلاق النار بين الجانبين، وسط مساعٍ أميركية لتثبيت التهدئة ودفع ترتيبات تنفيذه. وقال وزير الخارجية الأميركي ماركو روبي خلال حفل التوقيع: "يسرنا الاعلان عن اتفاق إطار بين الحكومة اللبنانية ذات السيادة وبالطبع حكومة إسرائيل، بوساطة ودعم من الولايات المتحدة".

mz.title: Provedor de Justiça destaca avanços e desafios do País nos 51 anos da Independência
mz.description: O Provedor de Justiça, Isaque Chande, afirmou que os 51 anos da Independência Nacional representam um marco importante na história de Moçambique, assinalado por conquistas significativas, mas também por desafios que continuam a exigir o empenho de todos os cidadãos. Falando à margem das celebrações do 25 de Junho, o Provedor de Justiça destacou os progressos alcançados pelo País, particularmente nos sectores da Educação e da Saúde, apontando a histórica Geração 8 de Março como um dos símbolos da aposta na formação de quadros nacionais após a Independência. “Houve avanços significativos na educação e na saúde. A Geração 8 de Março continua a ser uma referência histórica e um exemplo dos resultados alcançados pelo País ao longo destes anos”, afirmou. Apesar dos progressos registados, o Provedor de Justiça considerou que Moçambique continua a enfrentar desafios importantes, com destaque para a necessidade de reforçar a produção nacional e garantir a segurança alimentar da população. Segundo defendeu, o aumento da produção constitui um factor essencial para assegurar que nenhuma criança moçambicana passe fome ou fique privada de alimentos. “O desafio passa por aumentar a produção nacional para garantir melhores condições de vida para todos os moçambicanos. Isso só será possível com o envolvimento de cada cidadão no esforço de desenvolvimento do País”, sublinhou. O Provedor de Justiça manifestou ainda confiança de que, com o empenho colectivo e a participação activa da população, Moçambique poderá alcançar melhores resultados nos próximos anos e consolidar os ganhos obtidos desde a proclamação da Independência Nacional. As declarações foram feitas no âmbito das comemorações dos 51 anos da Independência Nacional, celebrados sob o signo da reflexão sobre o percurso do País e os desafios do seu desenvolvimento.
